bead.title: Step 5b — Anchor profile YAML (post-census)
bead.description: Land scripts/benchmark/profiles/<anchor>.yaml using the model selected in NEW6 (Step 0 census). Fields: id, provider.{type,model,base_url,api_key_env}, pricing (all four streams), limits (max_output_tokens, context_tokens, rate_limit_rpm/tpm), sampling.{temperature, reasoning}, versioning.{resolved_at, snapshot}. The snapshot field captures the resolved model snapshot ID at profile-creation time (since aliases drift). Loader test passes for it.
bead.acceptance: Anchor profile YAML lands with all v7 schema fields populated + resolved snapshot ID + resolved_at date; loader test passes; ddx-agent-bench profiles list shows it.
